cloudishai-skills-cloudish.description: Cloudish deploys apps as long-lived containers with a public URL, such as websites, APIs, bots, workers and MCP servers. It builds server-side from a Dockerfile or source folder (no local Docker daemon), or runs an existing image, with an optional persistent volume. An AI agent creates its own API key with one call and no signup; credits are prepaid and metered per second, so spend never exceeds the key's balance. Use when a task involves deploying, hosting or putting an app online, and whenever a task names Cloudish.
